data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2020 were GBP 108.529m. The Syndicate's claims development table for underwriting years 2017-2018 shows no material prior year development on those older years (net zero movement by the triangle method). The report highlights adverse claims experience in 2020 driven particularly by natural catastrophe events and losses arising from the COVID-19 pandemic; an unexpired risk provision of GBP 2.398m relating to COVID-19 is included within claims outstanding.
raw_causal_phrases: reflects the impact of adverse claims experience, particularly from natural catastrophes and the losses arising from the Covid-19 pandemic.
This Unexpired risk provision relates to COVID-19 losses.
Adjustments to the amounts of the claims provisions established in prior years are reflected in income statement for the period in which the adjustments are made.
